description: Sleevy is a read-later app for saving URLs, organizing them with folders and tags, and tracking read state across its clients and integrations. It also offers developer access through a REST API and an MCP server for AI agents.
summary: Sleevy exposes a REST API at `https://api.sleevy.app` with an OpenAPI spec and a streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://api.sleevy.app/mcp`; the REST API uses personal API keys and the MCP server uses OAuth, while health-check endpoints are public.
